Nina V: Postmortem follow-up: vendor auth + model-registry cascade. I created a lightweight action tracker: https://tracker.redwood/actions/INC-881. Please claim items and add ETA.

Tom H: i'll own registry local-cache prototype and integration test. plan: LRU cache for non-secret metadata, TTL=20s, snapshot fallback. ETA: 2026-02-04.

Priya S: i'll take auth retry/circuit config and alerting. will propose a backoff policy and add auth_retry_ratio dashboard. ETA: 2026-02-06.

ops-bot: Actions created: A-8811, A-8812, A-8813. Owners must update status within 48h.

Evan L: ops note 1: rotate 2 owners per action for 2-week coverage. ops note 2: add vendor ticket ID and contact in tracker.

Nina V: recurrence pattern: spikes coincide with credential rotations and heavy registry 5xx bursts. short-term mitigations: conservative retry budgets, local TTL cache, and routing to dedicated model-variants on failure.

Tom H: added PR link and unit tests to tracker. marked action as in_progress.

Priya S: proposed retry snippet in PR:
```
initial_backoff_ms=200
max_retries=3
max_backoff_ms=4000
jitter=true
circuit_breaker: threshold=8, window=60s
```
should dampen token storms.

Nina V: next steps: owners confirm by EOD, include vendor escalation IDs, and tag any cross-team reviews with "needs-ops-review". brief 15m sync tomorrow to validate ETAs.

Tom H: confirmed.

Priya S: confirmed, i'll open vendor support case and paste ID.

Evan L: I'll add a monthly vendor-dep resilience checkpoint to the incident cadence.

Nina V: thanks all. i'll post a short summary to all-hands after the sync.
